requirement_text: User must be able to approve one proposal, reject another, ask for revised plan, and keep the run open (partial approval is a required capability).

The primary workspace is 'Plan | Realizacja | Rezultaty'; these are projections of one Case, not separate stores or products. Plan defines result/nearest safe execution horizon; Realizacja shows what is happening/needs attention/who owns next move; Rezultaty exposes accepted deliverables, decisions, evidence, lineage and measured value.

Lightweight UI doctrine: high information density with low visual weight; compact semantic elements and restrained borders; one dominant work surface; no permanent palette/configuration wall; contextual +/popover/drawer/command palette; progressive disclosure from business outcome to technical diagnostics; Simple/Expert/List views over one canonical graph; no current heavy builder promoted unchanged as expert target; mobile uses a semantically equivalent list, not a compressed desktop canvas.

Initial host of the Case Workspace is My Work; the workspace must not depend on My Work layout so it can later be embedded beside or inside the main Teresa Chat without creating another planner or runtime.
Owner decision: The default UI is lightweight. Governance, graph configuration and diagnostics use progressive disclosure.

Every plan preview must show: selected autonomy level; actions Teresa may execute; actions requiring approval; scope, recipients, data and connections; time, cost and stop conditions; reversibility and audit behavior.

Canonical entry points are: direct module action; My Work 'Nowe zlecenie'; a template/Play; an existing Idea, Finding, Assessment gap, Finance/KPI signal, Decision or Initiative; later, a free-form conversation with Teresa.
Cross-mode invariant: My Work remains the shared attention system for direct and orchestrated work.
The lightweight Workspace must answer four questions before exposing implementation detail: What do we want to achieve? What is happening now? What needs attention? What results already exist?
Primary Polish IA is 'Plan | Realizacja | Rezultaty'; these are projections of one Case, not separate storage domains.
The first product surface lives inside the existing My Work shell and must preserve the frozen navigation and one Command Row rule.

The current 'Run agent' surface becomes a 'Zlecenia' entry with: a list of Cases/Zlecenia; filters and saved views; one shared attention queue through My Work; entry to the lightweight Case Workspace; direct links to native module work; an explicit 'Widok zaawansowany' entry for process design. It must not add a second task inbox, second approvals inbox or second top-level toolbar.

Later, Teresa adds a conversational entry to the same objects: conversation -> proposed Zlecenie card -> plan review -> same Case Workspace. Chat does not receive a private planner, Run state or deliverable store.
On a wide desktop Teresa may be a contextual side panel. On narrower viewports 'Rozmowa | Zlecenie' are tabs, not an on/off toggle.
The Zlecenia list follows the existing list/table canon: desktop uses table plus preview; mobile uses equivalent cards/list rows.

Required Zlecenia columns/row facts: name and expected outcome; type (one-step, flow, transformation); user-facing status; attention state; result progress (not merely node count); owner; next action; deadline; last activity.
Default Zlecenia priority order: requires my decision; blocked; overdue or expiring; active; recent.
Required Zlecenia saved views: 'Wymaga mojej uwagi'; 'Moje aktywne'; 'Zespół'; 'Szkice'; 'Zaplanowane'; 'Zakończone'.
Definition records and individual Runs must never be silently mixed as equivalent rows. A Zlecenie row may summarize the active/latest Run and link to its history.

Compact header contains: Zlecenie name; one-sentence outcome; status and health; owner and optional deadline; last confirmed update; one primary action appropriate to state; overflow actions; later, contextual 'Porozmawiaj z Teresą'. Scope, participants, autonomy, budget and full brief open in a drawer and do not create a permanent second header row.

Stable phase tabs are Plan (intended work and plan approval), Realizacja (live Run, attention and timeline) and Rezultaty (decisions, native deliverables, evidence and value). Unavailable phases remain visible with a reason, e.g. 'Realizacja — plan niezatwierdzony'.
Default Plan projection shows: outcome and definition of done; business steps; human/Teresa/system owner; owning module; expected native result; main dependency or gate; validation warning.

Three views over one plan definition: 'Prosty' (simple n8n-like visual projection for orientation and common edits), 'Ekspercki' (contracts, routing, policies, evidence), 'Lista' (mobile and accessibility-equivalent projection).

Switching views preserves the selected stepId, plan version, viewport/scroll and focus target. A change in one view appears immediately in the others. Stable route values are simple|expert|list; English names are identifiers only, never visible UI copy.
A flow node shows only: business label; type; executor; owning module; expected output; duration/wait indicator; validation or runtime status.
Edges mean 'after completion', 'after approval', 'if', 'parallel', 'after event' or 'after date'. Branch edges require text labels. Color is never the only differentiator.

The contextual capability palette opens through '+', search or insert-on-edge; categories are Moduły; Teresa/AI; Praca człowieka; Decyzje i zgody; Dane i dokumenty; Czekanie i zdarzenia; Sterowanie; Integracje.
A palette item names its capability, required input, created deliverable, owner module and availability. A block without a working executor is disabled and says what is missing.

Step detail first disclosure level is a compact drawer showing purpose, owner, inputs, result, approval, duration/wait, risk. 'Pełne szczegóły' exposes typed contracts, routing, policy, retry, timeout, idempotency, schemas, evidence and diagnostics. Secret values are never rendered.

Before material execution, plan review must summarize: outcome and success criteria; steps and owners; autonomy level; writes/side effects; approvals and human/external waits; data, connections and recipients; expected time/cost; risk and reversibility; validation issues; diff from the previous published version.
A small safe one-step plan may combine confirmation, creation and start into one 'Zatwierdź i rozpocznij' action; the preview remains explicit — one click means low ceremony, not hidden execution.

Default Run view (Realizacja overview) contains: health summary; active or waiting step; consolidated attention; next action; progress by results/milestones; time and cost; state-valid controls; business timeline.
Realizacja controls include Start, Zaplanuj, Wstrzymaj, Wznów, Anuluj, Ponów and Zaproponuj zmianę planu according to policy and role.

Each attention item states: what is required; why now; impact of no action; owner and deadline; Teresa's recommendation; evidence and freshness; available decisions; escalation or recovery. Governance and membership blocks are not rendered as generic errors.

The business timeline includes step transitions, human/external waits, approvals, deliverables, retries, pauses, replans, failures and outcome observations. Repeated technical heartbeats are aggregated; raw events and correlation IDs are contextual diagnostics.
The active Teresa Chat context is always explicit: 'Kontekst: [Zlecenie name] [Zmień] [Odłącz]'.

Every phase must supply honest states: Empty (explains absence, offers direct-module and Teresa/Zlecenie paths); Loading (preserves structure and last confirmed state, no full-screen reset for background refresh); Stale/offline (shows timestamp, disables unsafe mutations); Error (names failed action, persistence impact, recovery, correlation reference); Blocked (identifies reason, unblock owner, required action, consequence); Partial (states exactly which results are complete, unverified or missing); Permission denied (names required role/route without leaking protected content); Conflict (shows newer version, offers review/merge rather than silent overwrite).

Interaction principles: Lightweight first (outcome, current state, attention and next action precede configuration); visible controls, no hidden mode changes; tabs switch places/projections while toggles only change boolean settings; every mutation states actor, target, effect and reversibility; Teresa proposes changes to a draft or creates a version-bound proposal and never edits a published plan silently; drag-and-drop is an acceleration, never the only operation; live updates preserve focus, scroll and user drafts; deep links restore Case, phase, selected step/result and return focus; destructive actions require danger semantics, named consequence and confirmation; UI never substitutes animation for a durable state receipt.

The Workspace obeys one Command Row under the existing topbar. View-local controls such as 'Prosty | Ekspercki | Lista', zoom and timeline filters live inside the active view, not in another global toolbar.

Primary navigation: My Work remains the global attention origin; Plan|Realizacja|Rezultaty are semantic tabs; browser Back restores the prior My Work filter/preview or native deliverable return point; opening Teresa later does not change the Case context silently.
'Chat | Work' must never be implemented as a boolean toggle. Use split view on wide screens and semantic tabs on narrow screens.

A user may add/connect plan steps by clicking '+' between steps, searching the capability palette, dragging a capability onto a valid edge, using keyboard commands 'Dodaj przed'/'Dodaj po'/'Połącz z', or asking Teresa to propose a structural diff. The UI previews the insertion location and validates typed inputs/outputs; incompatible connections remain unapplied and explain the mismatch.
Selecting a node opens a compact drawer. 'Pełne szczegóły' changes to the expert projection with the same node selected. 'Pokaż na Flow' returns to and centers the same node.
Selection is neutral and uses the shared selected-state token. Crimson is reserved for Teresa brand presence and destructive semantics, never selection, normal CTA or focus.
Autosave states are 'Zapisywanie', 'Zapisano', 'Błąd zapisu'. Plan lifecycle states are 'Szkic', 'Do przeglądu', 'Opublikowany', 'Wycofany'. They are rendered independently.

For a small safe one-step plan, one primary action may create and start the work; before activation the compact preview still names outcome, native module/result, Teresa's allowed action, autonomy level, data/recipient scope, and side effect/approval behavior.

Wide desktop (>=1280px): Zlecenia uses table + preview; Plan may show canvas plus one inspector drawer; Realizacja may show main content plus an attention rail; Teresa may later open as a contextual right panel, never a permanent fourth column; floating panels use shared elevation, content cards remain shadowless.

Narrow desktop and tablet (768-1279px): one primary content region at a time; inspector and attention become drawers; 'Prosty | Ekspercki | Lista' remains visible as a segmented view control; Chat and Work later become tabs rather than compressed split view; the plan does not depend on a long fixed vertical canvas.

Mobile (<768px): default Plan projection is Lista; Step Detail is full-screen; Realizacja uses a vertical timeline and sticky attention action; approvals, provide-input, pause, resume and cancel remain fully operable; complex canvas authoring may be desktop-only but every semantic edit required for ordinary work has a list/form equivalent; actions use an accessible action sheet, no swipe-only command; sticky regions must not cover focused controls or the on-screen keyboard.

Accessibility target is WCAG 2.2 AA. Structure/focus: semantic landmarks and heading hierarchy; Plan|Realizacja|Rezultaty and view switchers use tablist/tab/tabpanel semantics; arrow keys move tab focus, Enter/Space activates per shared primitive contract; drawers/modals trap focus only while modal, close with supported dismiss behavior and return focus to the trigger; deep-linked content receives programmatic focus on its heading without unexpected scroll loops; all touch targets are at least 44x44 pt.

Canvas equivalence: every node is keyboard-focusable and announces label, type, owner and state; every edge appears in the selected node's textual 'Połączenia' section; add/connect/move/duplicate/delete have non-drag commands; the Lista projection exposes the same plan meaning and validation issues; keyboard navigation supports skip links to selected step and validation problems; zoom and pan are not prerequisites for reading or editing the plan.

Status/announcements: status is text plus optional icon/color, never color alone; aria-live=polite announces meaningful progress, reconnect and approval receipt; background event streams do not repeatedly announce technical heartbeats; error/block/partial messages name the consequence and available recovery; focus remains with the user's current task after live updates.

Motion, contrast and content: focus uses --c-focus, never crimson; motion uses shared --motion-fast/base/slow tokens and remains <=220ms; prefers-reduced-motion removes movement/scale and nonessential animation; light and dark modes meet contrast requirements; graphs/KPI charts provide text/table equivalents; icon-only actions have accessible names and tooltips where appropriate.
Feature screens compose shared components; they do not introduce a local visual language. Proposed reusable families require review and a binding entry before implementation.

Component binding plan: Workspace shell (header, one Command Row, phase tabs) binds to existing My Work shell in src/components/MyWork/MyWorkHub.tsx, no new parallel shell; List/preview binds to src/components/standard/ and AgentHubShell.tsx per TRIADA; Status extends central mapping in src/constants/statusColors.ts, no local status palette; Selection/focus uses src/components/shared/selectionTokens.ts and --c-focus in src/index.css; Flow candidate is AgentPlanCanvas.tsx, requires canonical Definition binding and list equivalent before acceptance; Palette/inspector candidates are AgentWorkshopPalette.tsx and agentWorkshopCatalog.ts, entries require executor contracts; Approval reuses shared decision/approval primitives, no chat-only governance duplicate; Timeline must use the shared timeline family, raw log styling is not a new default; Deliverable link requires a shared deep-link component across owner modules.

Visual rules: one colored primary action per active region; ordinary module CTA uses navy, Teresa presence may use brand crimson, destruction uses danger semantics; selection is neutral; content separation uses surfaces and spacing before borders; cards in cards are not the default; shadows are limited to floating UI and sticky elevation; Inter, flattened type hierarchy, font-semibold rather than bold headings; outline icons with consistent stroke; no gradient, glow or broad animation to signify AI.
UX mapping is Szkic | Do przeglądu | Opublikowany | Wycofany. Rejection is a review decision and returns the version to Draft or withdraws it; it is not a competing lifecycle state.
UI Częściowo zakończone derives from explicit PARTIAL, never from warnings or node counts.

Normative runtime-to-UI mapping: RUNNING/active NodeRun -> 'W toku'; WAITING_HUMAN assigned to viewer -> 'Czeka na Ciebie'; WAITING_HUMAN assigned elsewhere -> 'Czeka na zespół'; WAITING_TIMER or WAITING_EVENT within plan -> 'Czeka na system'; local blocker with remaining useful work -> 'Wymaga uwagi'; critical-path blocker -> 'Zablokowane'; terminal result acceptance PARTIAL -> 'Częściowo zakończone'; Case closure record accepted -> 'Zakończone'; CANCELLED -> 'Anulowane'.
Simple View is the guided vertical workflow evolved from AgentPlanCanvas.
Expert View is a React Flow graph evolved from My Work Process Flow primitives.
List View is the mobile, keyboard and accessibility-equivalent semantic editor.

UI reuse map: AgentHubShell KEEP as process/Case hub shell; AgentPlanCanvas ADAPT into Simple Graph View; AgentWorkshopPalette KEEP UI, replace catalog with Capability Registry; My Work IdeaProcessFlowTool primitives ADAPT into Expert Graph View; Process Flow validation/undo/layout EXTEND for execution semantics; Timeline and Run History components ADAPT to Run/NodeRun events; ArtifactRightPanel and PreviewPane KEEP for palette/properties/artifacts.

The approval card must show above the fold: what will happen and to which canonical object, material before/after or exact delta, evidence and known limitations, cost/risk/data class/recipients, reversibility or compensation path, alternatives and consequence of no approval, validity window and required role.
An attention request must ask for one concrete decision or input and show recommendation, alternatives, evidence, deadline and consequence of no response.
Required wording while monitoring remains open: 'DELIVERY ACCEPTANCE PASS / OUTCOME ACCEPTANCE PENDING'.
Polish product language: 'Zlecenie' is the default UI term; 'Case' remains the domain term. Consequence: copy can be natural without forking the model.
Builder direction: build new lightweight Simple and Expert views over one graph. Consequence: current heavy builder is only a temporary legacy surface and component donor.

A compact header shows name, outcome, status, health, owner, deadline, last confirmed update and one state-appropriate primary action. Full brief, scope, participants, autonomy and budget use contextual disclosure.
Stable tabs are Plan | Realizacja | Rezultaty. Unavailable phases stay visible with a reason. The shell uses the existing Consultify topbar and exactly one Command Row.

This is a SPEC-A full-object surface: Archetype C — Record, class L, using the existing artifact shell from ARTIFACT_ANATOMY_STANDARD.md; it is neither a dashboard nor a ModuleHub, and it is not a new local shell.

Menu 1 remains the product topbar, Menu 2 remains My Work navigation, and Plan | Realizacja | Rezultaty is Menu 3 inside the SPEC-A object shell. ArtifactRightPanel is the only contextual right-side inspector and is closed by default. Phase tabs never replace Menu 1 or Menu 2.
The Zlecenia index is a SPEC-L surface and must not reuse the full-object shell.
The Zlecenia list follows the shared list/table canon and prioritizes: 1) requires my decision; 2) blocked; 3) overdue or expiring; 4) active; 5) recent.

Each row answers: expected outcome, type, status, attention, result progress, owner, next action, deadline and last activity. Definition and Run records are not mixed as equivalent rows; the Case row may summarize and link to active and historical Runs.

Opening a native deliverable records the originating Case URL and control; Back returns to the same phase/step and restores focus. Missing, moved, unauthorized or retired targets show a reason and a safe route to Zlecenia.

Canonical labels are: Zlecenia, Plan, Realizacja, Rezultaty, Prosty, Ekspercki, Lista, Rozpocznij, Zaplanuj, Wstrzymaj, Wznów, Anuluj, Otwórz wynik, Wymaga Twojej decyzji, Oczekuje, Zablokowane, Częściowo zakończone and Brak dowodów. Product identifiers and literal evidence statuses (PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, WAITING, EVIDENCE_MISSING) may accompany, but never replace, a Polish explanation. 'Simple', 'Expert', 'List', 'Start' and 'Schedule' are not UI labels.

Every wait/error/partial message states: what happened; who acts now (Teresa, human or system); the impact; and the safe next action. Copy snapshots, truncation at 200% zoom and a pseudo-locale pass are mandatory.

The module uses high information density with low visual weight: one dominant work surface; no permanent palette or configuration wall; contextual +/popover/drawer/command palette; business outcome before graph mechanics; compact semantic elements and restrained borders; one primary action per active region; progressive disclosure from outcome to diagnostics; technical logs/identifiers hidden until requested; no current heavy builder promoted unchanged as the target; no decorative AI gradients, glow or continuous animation.

The Zlecenia list must use StandardModuleBar, StandardTable and StandardPreview from src/components/standard/* and pass TRIADA checks. Artifact surfaces must follow SPEC-A and the shared ArtifactRightPanel shell.

The default Plan shows: outcome and definition of done; business steps and nearest safe horizon; Teresa/human/system owner; native module and expected result; main dependencies, waits and approvals; validation issues; time, cost and autonomy summary.

The step drawer reveals purpose, input, output, owner, approval, wait and risk. Expert disclosure reveals routing, policy, schema, capability, retry, timeout, evidence and diagnostics. Secrets are never displayed.

The default execution view shows: health; active or waiting step; what requires attention; next action; progress by results/milestones (not only node count); time and cost; state-valid controls; business timeline.
The business timeline contains meaningful transitions, decisions, waits, deliverables, failures and recovery. Heartbeats and raw events remain in diagnostics.

Each result shows owner module, status, revision, approval, source freshness, evidence, lineage and 'Otwórz w [module]'. The deep link opens the canonical native object and returns to the same Case phase and selected step.
Target accessibility level is WCAG 2.2 AA.

Below 768 px the Zlecenia index becomes a single-column shared list-card projection, not a compressed table or bespoke card system. Each item shows outcome, status/attention, owner, deadline and next action; tap opens the Case. Filter, sort, saved views and settings remain in the Command Row; row actions use an accessible menu; selection and approved bulk actions use explicit controls. Preview opens as a full-screen sheet with the desktop descriptor and permission rules. There is no horizontal scroll or swipe-only behavior.

Accessibility invariants: complete keyboard path; visible --c-focus focus, never crimson; minimum 44x44 pt targets; semantic tabs, dialogs, drawers, menus and live regions; status is never color-only; canvas has List and textual connections equivalents; drag-and-drop has non-drag commands; live events never steal focus or force scroll; reduced motion and 200% zoom retain function; charts have text/table equivalents; deep links and overlays restore focus to the initiating control.

Every primary surface must handle: empty; initial loading and background refresh; slow network; stale/offline; validation error; permission or membership denial; concurrency conflict; rate limit; backend/provider failure; lost event connection and reconnect; governance block; partial completion; expired approval; unavailable source; restart during active Run.
No state may show fake success, silent failure, raw backend error as the only message or an infinite spinner without timestamp, timeout and recovery.
PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED and EVIDENCE_MISSING remain literal.
The heavy builder is only a compatibility shell/component donor.
No current heavy builder is presented as completed Expert UX.
In five seconds a user can identify outcome, state, attention and next action.
A LIGHT task has no project theatre or mandatory technical graph.
Simple, Expert and List preserve the same semantic graph and selection.
Contextual `+`, palette, drawer and details work without permanent walls.
Plan, execution and results deep links restore phase, selection and focus.
Human/external waits never look like infinite AI computation.
Errors explain impact and offer a safe recovery action.
Polish copy uses `Zlecenie` and names Teresa/system/human responsibility.
`PARTIAL`, `UNKNOWN`, `BLOCKED`, `WAITING` and `EVIDENCE_MISSING` remain literal.
Native results open in owning modules and return to Case context.
The Polish dictionary from document 12 is used; copy snapshots, pseudo-locale and 200% zoom truncation checks pass.
Zlecenia composes `StandardModuleBar`, `StandardTable` and `StandardPreview` from `src/components/standard/*`.
TRIADA checklist is completed 100%, item by item, with evidence or valid N/A.
Menu 1/2/3, table, settings, kebab, preview and actions follow canon.
Hairlines, density, spacing, typography and icon sizes use shared tokens.
Crimson is used only for permitted critical/destructive semantics.
Active state is neutral and focus is blue `--c-focus`.
No bespoke local table, preview, color system or AI decoration exists.
Dark and light modes both pass visual review.
W2-V0 prototype revision and external Piotr preliminary approval are recorded before the first production UI implementation commit.
Zlecenia is SPEC-L and its reviewed capabilities, preview and row-action descriptors govern desktop and mobile behavior.
Full Case uses the existing SPEC-A Archetype C — Record, class L artifact shell (not a dashboard or ModuleHub); phases occupy Menu 3 and the shared `ArtifactRightPanel` is contextual.
Canonical routes, redirects, deep-link return and focus restoration pass.
Applicable object screens follow SPEC-A shell and archetype.
`ArtifactRightPanel`, shared menus, tokens and native editor are reused.
Deliverables are readable, editable and visually correct after cold reopen.
DOCX/PPTX/XLS open natively and share the accepted facts digest.
Required artifact checklist and render evidence pass before owner review.
200% zoom retains content and every required action.
Keyboard-only journeys have no focus trap or unreachable action.
Esc closes the most local layer and focus returns correctly.
Canvas has List/text equivalent and drag has non-drag alternatives.
VoiceOver and NVDA critical paths pass.
Automated a11y has zero critical/serious findings.
Reduced motion is respected; live Teresa regions use polite semantics.
Touch targets meet 44 x 44 pt where required.
Menu 2 pill controls: h-9 rounded-full, visible border, flat bg, icon 16 + label text-sm.
Active Menu 2 pill = filled with a distinctly different NEUTRAL color, never crimson.
Menu 2 right side order (toward center): primary CTA -> view-switcher segment (list/kanban/calendar) -> additional filters.
Menu 2 never shows counters (counters live only in Menu 3).
Menu 3 has exactly three interchangeable modes in the same bar: filters-with-counters, bulk action bar (>=1 row selected), and dynamic open-item tabs (tab + x).
Table header: text-[11px] uppercase, sticky; sort by header click (arrows); per-column filter funnel; hairline under header.
Rows separated ONLY by a subtle hairline (light and dark) - never a thick/white band, never zebra striping.
Row = semibold title + optional gray subtitle; subtitle visibility is toggled by the 'Show row description' setting.
Checkbox on the left of every row toggles Menu 3 into bulk-action mode.
Status = quiet dot chip; priority = dot + toned text (Critical = reddish TEXT, not a filled pill). Zero filled pills for priority.
Empty cell = '—'. Numbers right-aligned (tabular-nums). Kebab menu at end of row.

Settings2 icon top-right of table is MANDATORY, opens a 'VISIBLE COLUMNS' popover: column checkboxes (Task/Actions locked), with a 'Show row description' toggle at the bottom - identical popover in every table in the app.

Row kebab has 5 fixed blocks in fixed order: (1) entry+close, (2) state transitions, (3) time/due-date actions, (4) universal Open preview/Edit/Archive (unready items shown disabled with a note, never hidden), (5) destructive (always last, separated, red - the only red in the menu).
Kebab renders exactly 2 separators / 3 visual zones (TOP/BOTTOM/DANGER) - not a separator between every one of the 5 blocks.

Preview has 6 blocks top-to-bottom: (1) header title+pin+Open(only Open in preview)+x, (2) meta card with status/priority chips+due date+recommendation line, (3) DETAILS with '~N words' + kebab (Copy/Export/Download - exports ONLY here), (4) AI card with entity-matched action chips, (5) Relations (clickable pills or 'No relations'), (6) Actions grid 2 columns: row1 resolutions, row2 informational, row3 time/escalation.

Preview action buttons are pills (rounded-full) per owner decision D21 - rounded-lg on a preview action button is a canon violation. 4-5 stabilized variants: positive/destructive/warning/neutral/primary (max one primary, never crimson).
Kanban columns = zones, not boxes: no background/border; empty columns always visible with a placeholder (icon + greyed 'No...').

Kanban card: ~3px left accent bar (amber=pending, red=critical; CRITICAL also gets a subtle bg tint - the ONLY surface color), drag handle, semibold title 2 lines, gray description 2 lines, quiet priority/type chips, project chip, footer with due date + avatar.

Red = exclusively critical semantics (overdue/error/blocked/delete). Active UI states = neutral. Focus = blue (never accent/crimson); text editors have no focus outline. Tailwind's 'primary' token = crimson #85182F and is forbidden as a UI color.

Canonical color tokens (light/dark, source src/index.css): c-bg, c-surface, c-surface-raised, c-border-subtle (row hairline), c-border, c-border-strong, c-focus/c-focus-solid (blue, never crimson), success/warning/danger/info semantics, c-accent = crimson #85182F reserved ONLY for brand, never UI.
Radius scale: xs 6px (badge/chip), sm 8px (input/small card), md 12px (card/modal), lg 16px (panel/drawer), xl 20px (hero), pill 9999px (pills/toggles).
All spacing in multiples of 4px (4/8/12/16/20/24/32/40/48). Table row cell padding px-3 py-2.5 (title py-3), checkbox px-2 py-2.5.
Gap between Menu 3 and the table header = mb-2 (8px), enforced in MENU_3_ROW_CLASS (ModuleMenu3.tsx), not per-screen.
The DETAILS block word count describes PROSE only; when the block carries a file list or a properties table, showWordCount must be false.
Entity key-value properties are never joined into a prose paragraph; StandardPreview.details takes properties: ArtifactPropertyRow[] and renders via ArtifactPropertiesTable.

Row kebab never shows stub/fake items for unbuilt features (filtered by czyAtrapa); items disabled by a genuine business rule stay visible with the reason stated in the item; a kebab with nothing left after filtering is not rendered at all.
Preview pane width clamp(340px, 28%, 480px); separation from table gap-1.5 (no border-l); action footer space-y-2.5 with no dividers between cards.

Full Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through every interactive element on screen without a focus trap; every clickable element (including <div onClick> grid/kanban cards) must be keyboard-reachable via tabIndex=0 + role=button + Enter/Space.
Esc closes only the most-local layered element, in order: open kebab/dropdown -> preview -> modal/drawer (one press = one close, not everything at once).

Focus must be VISIBLE (focus-visible:ring-2 ring-[color:var(--c-focus)], never primary-*/crimson) on every interactive element; zero focus:outline-none without a visible replacement; text editors may substitute a border/underline color change for the full ring.

Any region where an AI response streams in (Teresa chat/panel, 'AI writing...', 'generating' cards) MUST have a container with role=log (or role=status for short indicators) + aria-live=polite + aria-relevant='additions text'.

For every feature on a table surface the contract must state: whether it's mandatory/conditional/forbidden; its one canonical location; its measurable anatomy; mouse+keyboard behavior; loading/empty/error/disabled states; data source/persistence; required acceptance evidence. Missing features cannot be masked with 'Coming soon'.

Every table declares a TableSurfaceCapabilities descriptor (id, entity, hasTable, selection, preview, fullOpen, edit, archive, delete, dueDate, contextTransitions, viewModes, menu3Presets, bulkActions, persistKey) before implementation.

selection:none is legal only with product justification (then no checkboxes/bulk); not-applicable features are omitted, not rendered as a stub; supported-but-unavailable-for-a-record features stay visible as clearly muted/disabled with the reason recorded in the descriptor; 'Coming soon'/'Wkrótce'/empty handlers are forbidden in production menus.

Menu 1 is a horizontal app-context bar above Menu 2 (sidebar is NOT Menu 1): left = breadcrumb 'Module > active tab'; right = Data -> Model -> system icons -> profile; no domain actions of the table; one row, fixed app height.
Menu 2 controls are h-9 rounded-full, border, px-3, gap 8px, icon 16px, label 14px medium; active tab has neutral fill; Menu 2 never shows counters.

Menu 2 right side, left-to-right order: (1) max one complex Filters dropdown when needed, (2) view-mode segment only when >=2 views exist, (3) at most one domain tool, (4) primary CTA, (5) Area/panel toggle only if part of the global module layout.

Menu 2 forbids: counters; more than one primary CTA; search input/folders/status presets/bulk actions in the right cluster; a 'Table' dropdown instead of an icon segment; view modes placed in Menu 3; the same filter appearing in more than one place.
Menu 3 is exactly one row (px-4 py-2, 8px gap to table); filter chip h-7 px-2.5 11px pill border; bulk button h-8 pill border; state priority is bulk > open-tabs > filters.

Menu 3 Formula 1 (filters): left = counter-chip presets/scope, every chip shows a count including 0; active chip has neutral fill + reset; right = at most five bulk/AI actions with the rest in overflow; result counter updates on filter change.

Menu 3 Formula 2 (bulk, only for selection:bulk): appears immediately on selection; left cluster = 'N selected' -> Clear(X) -> shared actions -> contextual actions -> danger last; all buttons share the same outline shell; always at least one real action besides Clear; danger requires confirmation; Clear restores Formula 1.

Menu 3 Formula 3 (open tabs): single-click on a row opens preview and does NOT create a tab; Open opens the full object plus a persistent tab (icon, real title, x); x closes the tab and restores the list without losing filters/sort/scroll.

Mandatory table anatomy: Settings2 top-right; checkbox header+row present ONLY for selection:bulk (absent entirely for selection:none); first data column identifies the record and is flexible width; kebab is the last column, right-aligned; sticky header 11px/600/uppercase/muted/hairline; no zebra and no status background on rows, separated by hairline; title 14px semibold, description 11px muted max 2 lines; empty cell always '—'; numbers right-aligned tabular-nums; status = neutral shell + dot; priority = dot + toned text.

Every table must declare the minimal domain column set needed to identify, compare, and handle records without opening each one; missing a decision-critical property is a FAIL just like a missing visual element (e.g. Materials must show format/type). Between Menu 3 and the table, no charts, KPIs, simulations, dashboard cards, forms, or a second toolbar may be placed.

Cells px-3 py-2.5 (title py-3, checkbox px-2 py-2.5); row height is stable regardless of description toggle; resize is zero-sum and persisted; column visibility/order persisted via persistKey; sort by header click; per-column filter for finite taxonomies; single scroll container; the sticky-header ancestor must never have overflow:hidden.

Single-click = select active record + open preview, without changing the URL; checkbox toggles selection only and never opens preview; Enter/double-click = full Open; right-click = context menu for the pointed record; hover, active-record, and bulk-selection are three visually distinct states.

Settings2 trigger is 32x32px with a 16px icon; opens a portal popover 'VISIBLE COLUMNS'; the identifier column and Actions are Required/locked; 'Show row description' is the last element; visibility, description toggle, and order are all persisted.

Loading preserves row count and approximate column widths; empty distinguishes no-data from no-filter-results with a sensible CTA/reset; error shows a description and Retry; no state is a blank surface.

Preview is mandatory for every table surface; default closed; single-click opens it without changing URL, filters, or scroll; width clamp(340px, 28%, 480px); gap to table 6px, no own border-left; Esc and x close it, focus returns to the record.

Preview has six blocks in a fixed order: header (title->pin->Open->x), Meta, Details (prose or properties + local Copy/Export/Download kebab), AI (own card, only if the entity declares real AI actions), Relations (or canonical 'No relations'), Actions (2-column grid). AI may be omitted if no real action exists; all other blocks are mandatory and show a canonical empty state.

Exactly one Open button exists in the entire preview (header); word count applies only to prose and disappears for properties/list/empty; properties use a key-value table; exports occur ONLY in the Details kebab; action button = 36px pill border icon+label, at most one primary; variant follows the effect (positive/destructive/warning/neutral); a single real action occupies the grid's first column - never pad with a stub in the second column, never turn a destructive action into a dominant primary.

Preview wrapper p-3 (12px), 10px gap between cards, 6px gap to table, neutral working background; each card is 100% width, radius 12px, border 1px c-border-subtle, bg c-surface, padding 12px, no heavy shadow; no vertical border-left and no divider between cards; block height budget: Header 52px, Meta 88px, Details min 200px (preferred 220-280px), AI 76px (only w/ real AI actions), Relations 64px, Actions ~60/106/152px for 1/2/3 rows; absent AI hands its space to Details, not an empty slot; only one page-level scroll is allowed, never a double scroll.

Preview header layout: title -> flexible space -> Pin -> Open -> x. Title Inter 14px semibold, one line truncate with full accessible name/tooltip; Pin and x have a 32x32px target; Open is h-8; icons 16px; control gap 4px; canonical icons Pin/ArrowUpRight/X; Open appears exactly once in the whole preview.

Preview Meta row 1 (28px): left = status, priority, optional importance/type; right = due date or the most important time value. Chip: h-6 pill 11px gap6 dot6. Row 2: recommendation/key context, 11-12px, max 2 lines, 8-18 words recommended, hard max 24 words; never generate filler text to pad the card.

Details header 28px (label 11px semibold uppercase + optional '~N words' + local 28x28 kebab). Prose variant: 80-140 words soft max 160, 13px/20-21px line-height, 2-3 short paragraphs, scroll or 'Show more' above the limit, word count visible. Properties: 5-8 key rows, 28-32px each, label 11px muted/value 12-13px, no word count. File-list: max 5 items no scroll, 16px format icon + name + format + optional size, overflow via 'Show all N', no word count. Local Details kebab order is strictly Copy -> Export -> Download; exports occur nowhere else in preview.

AI card is 76px and appears only for real actions; shows max 3 actions directly plus one overflow; button h-8 pill gap6 text 11-12px, label 1-3 words (max ~24 chars); a subtle AI icon token is allowed but no large purple background; AI is not automatically primary.

Relations card is 64px, label 'RELATIONS', max 4 visible pills + '+N' overflow; pill h-7, icon 14-16px, text 11px, border, neutral bg, truncate at ~24 chars with tooltip; no relations renders canonical 'No relations'.

Actions grid is 2 columns, max 3 rows, max 6 direct actions; button h-9, vertical gap 10px, card padding 12px; a lone action occupies the first column, never padded with a stub; overflow goes into the full record kebab. Button: h-9 pill border 1px px-3 icon16 gap8 text 12-13px medium, label 1-3 words (max ~22 chars), optional neutral shortcut badge, blue focus. Exactly five variants: primary, positive, warning, destructive, neutral - color follows effect not module, primary is navy, max one, never crimson.

Canonical action->icon registry (Open=ArrowUpRight, Open preview=PanelRightOpen, Complete=CheckCircle2, Approve=BadgeCheck, Reject=XCircle, Delete=Trash2, Edit=Pencil, Archive/Restore=Archive/ArchiveRestore, Assign=UserPlus, Delay/Snooze=Clock3, Copy/Export/Download=Copy/FileDown/Download, etc.). The same action uses the same icon in every module; a change requires updating the global registry, not a local screen decision.

Every table declares a PreviewSurfaceDescriptor (title source, Meta fields, Details source/mode, word/row limits, real AI actions, relation types, max three Actions rows); each action declares actionId, label, canonical icon, one of the five variants, capability, optional confirmation, and shortcut. Missing descriptor blocks automatic preview PASS.
Preview and kebab need not have an identical action set, but if the same action appears in both it must share the same actionId, label, permission, confirmation, and effect.
Kebab trigger is the last column, min hit target 32x32px, 16px icon, visible blue focus; menu is portalled, right-aligned to the trigger, auto-flips, and is never clipped.

Kebab zones always appear in the order context -> manage -> danger; empty zones are not rendered; a separator appears only between two adjacent rendered zones - typically 3 zones/2 separators, legally 2 zones/1 separator if context is absent.

Kebab 'manage' zone fixed order within declared capabilities: 1. Open preview (always); 2. Edit (unless capability is not-applicable; unavailable = quietly disabled, no extra comment); 3. Archive/Restore (if archive capability = supported); 4. Delay (if dueDate=true, opens a preset submenu).

Delete/Reject/Move to trash is always last and red; 'supported' = active with confirmation; 'business-locked' = visible but lighter/disabled with the reason kept in the descriptor (not appended to the menu label); the reason 'Coming soon' is not allowed.

Forbidden in kebab: a flat legacy array without a 'kind'; open/ai/convert/output sections that break the three visual zones (special actions must map into context or manage by effect); duplicate View/Open/Open-preview with the same effect; stub items and empty handlers; more than two separators.

Kebab menu: portal, context-menu z-index layer, min-width 220px, max-width 320px, vertical padding 6px, radius 12px, border 1px c-border-subtle, bg c-surface-raised, elevation-2; right-aligned to the trigger (+/-5px), 12px viewport clearance, auto-flip, never clipped by the table. Item: h-9, px-3, gap 8px, icon 16px, label 13px medium, optional shortcut 11px muted on the right. Only Delete/Reject/Move-to-trash gets red text/icon and a subtle red hover, never a full bright fill. Separator: 1px c-border-subtle, 4px vertical margin.

The right-click context menu is a second trigger of the exact same RowActionRegistry as the kebab, not a separate configuration: actionId, label, icon, order, visible/disabled state, reason, confirmation, and handler must be identical - it differs ONLY in anchor point (cursor vs button), sets the active record on open, and returns focus to the row (not the trigger) on close. No action may exist only in the right-click menu; implementation must not have a separate action array, separate labels, or local sorting.

Focus is always blue (--c-focus), never crimson; crimson never signals active tab, selection, or primary CTA; red is reserved for danger/error/blocked/overdue/critical; every icon-only control has an accessible name; Esc closes only the most local layer (submenu -> menu -> preview -> modal); animations <=220ms and respect reduced motion; destructive actions always require confirmation; a real action must have a handler, feedback, and a data update.

Canonical visual acceptance is done at CSS viewport 1440x900, 100% zoom; a mandatory minimum-desktop test is done at 1280x720, 100% zoom (overflow/grouping/collapsing of secondary controls is allowed there, but truncated labels, overlapping controls, an obscured active tab, off-viewport elements without an alternative, or lost functionality are not). Preview at 1280x720 must not reduce the table to an unusable width - the identifying column and action access must remain.

Artifact anatomy has 6 spatial zones, 5 identical for every artifact, only the center is free: Menu 1 artefaktu (thin identity bar: back/breadcrumb, inline-editable title, lifecycle status, save state, index link, ONE primary CTA on the right, nothing else), Menu 2 (edit toolbar, text artifacts only), Menu 3 (context actions + view-local controls + AI on the right), left rail (verb tools, disappears entirely when empty - no reserved space), center (the only truly free zone), right panel (accordion of noun properties + secondary actions, always present), optional footer.
Descent rule: entering an artifact replaces the module's Menu 2/Menu 3 with the artifact's own Menu 1/Menu 2; breadcrumb is the way back; never more than 3 horizontal bars stacked at once.

5 archetypes (A Canvas, B Document, C Record, D Matrix, E Deck) x 2 size classes: class S (single view, opens in a side panel/modal, no artifact Menu 2/3) and class L (multiple internal views, full workspace, artifact Menu 2/3 active).

SPEC-A shared shell is identical across all 5 archetypes: Menu 1 (breadcrumb, type icon, inline title, lifecycle status, save indicator, index link, one primary CTA), Menu 3 (internal nav as pill or underline + view-local controls + AI on the right; class S has no Menu 3), right panel accordion in fixed section order Actions -> Properties -> Relations -> Comments -> History/AI, and identical PPM/kebab/states/overlays to List. Only the center + Menu 2 + rail differ per archetype.

An archetype changes ONLY the center + Menu 2 + left rail; the rest of the shell is shared - e.g. Initiative (C-L, 20 internal screens) and a question sheet (C-S, 1 screen) share the exact same shell, only density differs.

SPEC-A build-ready shell dimensions: Menu 1 artefaktu 60px (px-16, c-surface, bottom border), Menu 2 48px, Menu 3 44px, left rail 56px/240px, right panel 360px default (allowed range 320-420px per SYS-2 §9.1a).
Menu 1 detailed order left-to-right: back icon-20 h-32, divider, type icon-16, inline title L2 (click -> input), lifecycle status, 'Saved *' L5 muted || right: [index] ghost h-32, primary h-36.

Lifecycle status must be a TEXT PILL, never a bare dot: shrink-0, whitespace-nowrap, h-5 px-2 rounded-md, 11px medium, tone mapped to c-* tokens by status (draft/neutral, review, approved, rejected); crimson is forbidden on status.

Save indicator is a separate non-clickable text span ('Zapisywanie.../Zapisano/Blad zapisu'), 12px, c-text-muted (error -> c-text-danger), shrink-0, and is a status message, not a control - a second action button pretending to be 'Save' is removed.
Object code and permalink move off the Menu 1 bar entirely into an overflow kebab ('Copy object code' + 'Copy link'); zero code/permalink buttons remain on the Menu 1 bar itself.
At rest the title is a truncate span (not an input) so a long title ends in an ellipsis instead of stretching the bar; clicking switches to inline edit (unless titleReadOnly).

Open-mode rule (state, not per-card property): a Draft/empty card opens in EDIT mode; an Approved/ready card opens in PREVIEW/read mode. Hard exceptions: Tool is always read-only; Notification always opens for edit (worksheet); Interview always opens for edit (active workshop).
Canonical bar heights: Menu 1 artefaktu = 60px (never lowered to 48px), Menu 2 = 48px, Menu 3 = 44px target (documented debt: real code renders Menu 3 at approx. 48px via MENU_3_ROW_CLASS).

Menu 3 uses pill for equal-rank sections / underline for sub-views + view-local controls + AI on the far right. Class S artifacts have NO Menu 2 or Menu 3 at all - they open as a drawer/modal with content in the right-panel-as-center.

Right panel accordion has 5 sections in fixed order: Actions (Export PDF/Word/PPTX, Share, Copy-link), Properties (label L4 + value L3, owner avatar, dates, switch-flags, slider-params), Relations (type icon-16 + title L3 + arrow, '+ Link'), Comments (avatar + text + timestamp), History/AI (timeline + sparkles AI actions); section header h-44 L1 + chevron-16 rotating 200ms.
Behaviors: Cmd+S=save, Cmd+Enter=primary action, Esc=back/close, breadcrumb=navigate up, right panel becomes a drawer below 1280px width.
An archetype must NEVER change the shell - Menu 1/right panel/kebab/states are identical regardless of archetype; Initiative (C-L) and a question sheet (C-S) share the exact same shell.

Canonical open ladder: list row single-click -> preview in the right panel (read-only); click title / 'Open full' -> full page (class L) or drawer (class S); list 'New' -> quick-create modal (minimal fields) -> full artifact after save; relation link in the right panel -> target artifact (full/drawer); deep-link URL -> full page with breadcrumb reconstructed; instrument node/bar click -> source artifact drawer over the instrument.

Class S (Task, Decision, KPI, RAID, Insight...) = drawer from the right over the current context; direct deep-link access is a full page. Class L (Initiative, Assessment, Deck...) = full page with its own shell. Quick-create is ALWAYS a modal, never a drawer.

Unsaved changes: closing/back with dirty state triggers a confirm modal ('Save / Discard / Cancel') - never a silent discard. Save indicator shows Saved/Saving/Save failed in Menu 1, separate from lifecycle. Transitions are 200ms ease-hig (drawer=slide, modal=scale-in, full page=route+breadcrumb, zero bounce). Locked/no-permission artifacts open read-only with a banner explaining why - never a raw 403.

DoD Artifact MUST checklist: Menu 1 with all specified elements; shell varies only by archetype (center/Menu2/rail), panel/kebab/states identical; right panel section order Actions/Properties/Relations/Comments/History-AI; relations clickable and first-class; AI slot (sparkles) in a fixed location; opening per the open ladder with unsaved-changes guard; honest empty/loading/error states; light+dark readable using c.* tokens only; zero crimson on focus/status/default-badge/selection; full Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through the shell without a focus trap including clickable divs; Esc closes the most local active layer first; visible focus-visible ring in c.focus never primary/crimson; Teresa streaming regions use role=log + aria-live=polite + aria-relevant; wizards/generators must fully satisfy the §13.7 contract; Canvas archetype AI-scope contract (§13.3a) and canvas keyboard minimum set (§13.3c, mandatory, caps runtime_status at PARTIAL if missing).

DoD Instrument MUST checklist: frame per §15.2; interaction invariants per §15.3; atoms only from the 40-element pool (zero local ones); palette rule (series = c.tag-*, states = semantic, crimson never as data; legend when >1 series); progressive disclosure (overview -> click -> detail); meaning never encoded by color alone; zero production test data; empty state teaches; light+dark readable.

>=1280px: full layout (rail+center+right panel side by side). 1024-1280: right panel becomes a toggleable drawer, rail stays. 768-1024: rail becomes a drawer, single column, preview becomes full, Menu 3 scrolls horizontally. <768 (mobile): stacked, class-S becomes a bottom-sheet, Menu 2 scrolls horizontally, read mode + light actions only (no full canvas editing on mobile).

PL+EN, sentence case (UPPERCASE only for the L1 kicker); buttons lead with a verb ('Zapisz', not 'Zapisywanie'); empty states teach ('Dodaj pierwsza inicjatywe', not 'No data'); errors are human, never raw/[object Object]/code; zero developer jargon in UI.

Focus always visible and blue (c.focus); full keyboard navigation; text contrast >=4.5:1 (large text >=3:1); meaning is never conveyed by color alone (status = color+label+dot); ARIA on interactive elements; prefers-reduced-motion respected.

Animate panel/drawer/modal entries (200ms ease-hig), streaming, skeleton-pulse, hover-reveal (100ms). Never animate bounce/spring (brand-moment only), layout jumps, or flicker in the product. Everything <=220ms.
Default density is 'comfortable' with a 'compact' toggle (tables already have it, extend to grid/instrument); numbers use tabular-nums everywhere; 4px grid with no exceptions.

Color only through c.* tokens, zero navy-*/slate-*/hex in new code (ESLint gate); crimson/primary NEVER on focus, status, default badge, AI-bubble background, or empty-state icon; focus is always blue c.focus, danger is always c.danger (not crimson); every element must be one of the §9.2 catalog entries, no local variants; light and dark are both tested (DoD §5).

Button variants: primary = navy/high-contrast bg (dark: light bg/navy text), NEVER crimson, used for the one main action (Menu 1 CTA); secondary = transparent+border; danger = c.danger bg; ghost = transparent, hover raised bg. All share radius-lg, 12px x h-9, icon16+label, blue focus. A button ALWAYS carries a text label.

Empty state: icon-24 c.text-muted + L2 title + L4 description + primary 'what to do next' CTA (never 'No data'). Loading: skeleton bg c.surface-raised, higSkeleton pulse, layout preserved. Error: c.danger icon + human L3 message + retry action (never raw/[object Object]).

SYS-2 width resolution: list preview pane = clamp(340px, 28%, 480px) (implemented canon, TableWithPreviewLayout.tsx). Artifact right panel / form drawer = 360px default, 320-420px allowed range, wide form drawer 420px (FOUNDATION_TOKEN_CONTRACT §4). These are TWO DIFFERENT surfaces allowed different values; 320-380 and 400-480 are retired, non-canon. General Drawer/Sheet has 4 discrete variants (sm=256, md=320, lg=384, xl=480), not a continuous range.

Canvas (archetype A) AI scope contract, MUST: 3 selectable-from-UI scope levels (field=selected node, section=branch/subtree, tool=whole canvas); scope MUST be named in the UI before running, including the default when nothing is selected; AI output is always a proposal/diff (never an immediate graph mutation) with per-node and bulk approve/reject; undo of an AI operation is a single unit; canceling a stream leaves zero side effects. Status: conditional/inactive gate (K-44, 2026-08-02) until a given canvas implements its first scope picker - none of the six canvases do today.

Canvas minimum keyboard set (no mouse): create node, navigate between nodes, move a node, connect nodes, delete (with confirmation if it has children), exit the canvas (Esc). Until implemented and verified, that canvas cannot exceed runtime_status PARTIAL and does not pass DoD §18.1.

Wizard/generator behavioral contract (MUST, 10 points): 'Step N of M' shown textually with aria-live announcement; Back available on every step except the first/mutation-in-progress, without clearing earlier fields; Save-draft mechanism explicitly defined; Cancel must disambiguate 'keep draft' vs 'discard changes' (bare 'Cancel' forbidden); resumes on the same step after refresh; inline validation at the field plus focus on the first invalid field; a review step shows the scope of consequences before an irreversible mutation; an Idempotency-Key header (not a payload field) generated client-side per session x execution-step, server TTL >=24h, a repeated key returns the cached result or 409 (never a silent duplicate); partial-failure gets a dedicated success/failure list UI, retry acts only on failed items with a new per-element key; generation shows visible progress with a safe Stop and safe exit/recovery, success opens the new artifact's workspace (not just a toast).

Menu locations: Menu 1 app (global topbar) is always visible/persistent; Menu 1 artefaktu replaces the module's Menu 2 on entering an artifact; the kebab opens with either a click on the (vertical-dots) icon OR a right-click - the same menu either way; Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the command palette.
